verdict.rationale: EBANX's own API error-code docs list a 'Lock for preventing customer to be billed twice for the same transaction', so it has a first-party duplicate-charge guard. The evidence does not show a documented idempotency-key mechanism or explicit safe-retry semantics. missing for 10: documented idempotency key parameter/header, explicit guidance that any request can be safely retried, coverage across all endpoints (payouts, refunds, captures), independent or hands-on corroboration.
